_comment: Zod is imported by a bare specifier rather than 'npm:zod@...' inline so
the same module can be type-checked and unit-tested from Vitest, which
cannot resolve npm: specifiers. Deno resolves it through this map; Vitest
resolves it through node_modules, where the identical version is pinned as
a devDependency. Validation code that could not be tested is what let
confidence: 'banana' reach the UI, so being able to test it is the point.
Keep the version here and in package.json in step.
